description: Read your workspace's saved instrumentation setup for usage signals (kind events) or costs (kind costs): the framework and language its snippets are for, the templates, and the agent, customer and API key prefix the setup provisioned (never the key), or the defaults when nothing is saved. The one click setup that creates the agent, customer and API key is not offered here: it mints a key, so it takes a person signed in to the dashboard (/event-tracking or /cost-tracing). Answers 404 until the in-app setup is switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

kind.description: events for usage signals (/event-tracking), costs for cost tracing (/cost-tracing).

name: get_instrumentation_setup
